name: threaded_unified
description: Threaded unified variant of jev_reaction_type. Pre-loop: balance -> functional groups -> pH -> one unified_preanalysis LLM call that returns conditions, missing reagents, atom mapping and the reaction-type label together (no Jev; the answer is replayed through the old tools and checked deterministically, with one repair turn). Loop: mechanism-step proposals continue one chat thread that starts from the pre-analysis exchange (loop_module.conversation_mode = 'threaded'); a failed proposal is dropped by forking back to the last accepted step and kept only as a short avoid note; backtracking forks to the branch step; the thread is compacted to a path summary plus the last two steps past max_prompt_chars. step_atom_mapping is off; candidate rescue stays a separate stateless call. Behaviour-changing: needs eval-tier evidence against jev_reaction_type.
execution_note: Modules execute in listed order within each phase. pre_loop_modules runs once before the loop; loop_module runs each iteration before post_step_modules; post_step_modules runs after each accepted mechanism step. Array position (step field) is the authoritative execution sequence.

pre_loop_modules.label: Check Atom Balance
pre_loop_modules.description: RDKit counts atoms on each side of the reaction. Reports whether starting materials and products are stoichiometrically balanced, and lists any deficit or surplus atoms. Runs once at the start.

pre_loop_modules.label: Identify Functional Groups
pre_loop_modules.description: SMARTS pattern matching identifies reactive functional groups (alcohols, ketones, amines, etc.) and leaving groups across all starting materials and products. Runs once; output informs atom-mapping context.

pre_loop_modules.label: Recommend pH
pre_loop_modules.description: Rule-based pH suggestion (user pH, Dimorphite-DL profile or acid/base heuristic). Feeds the unified pre-analysis prompt.

pre_loop_modules.label: Unified Pre-Analysis (conditions, reagents, mapping, reaction type)
pre_loop_modules.description: One forced tool call (unified_preanalysis_result) with four sections, each holding the arguments of the old tool: conditions, missing_reagents, atom_mapping, reaction_type. With hidden products only conditions and reaction_type are asked for. Each section is replayed through its old tool so the old step names and output shapes are recorded (source deterministic, derived_from unified_preanalysis). Checks (core/preanalysis_checks.py): conditions parse and pH 0-14; reagents leave no deficit (hard failure pauses the run); rdkit-agent atom-map check; exact taxonomy label or no_match. One repair turn for failed sections. When all sections pass, the exchange becomes the root of the mechanism-loop chat thread.

loop_module.label: Propose Mechanism Step
loop_module.description: Core LLM call executed each iteration of the mechanism loop, as a turn of one chat thread. The first turn (and the first after a compaction) carries the full proposal prompt; later turns send the step index, current state, changed guidance and reproposal notices. Each turn opens with what was applied last turn and, on a reproposal, a short list of the candidates already rejected for this step and why.

outputs: candidates (ranked list of intermediate_smiles, resulting_state, reaction_smirks, electron_pushes, step_label)

post_step_modules.label: Check Bond/Electron Conservation
post_step_modules.description: Parses the DBE metadata tags from the reaction SMIRKS and verifies that bond-order and electron-count changes sum to zero. Part of the mechanism step validation; re-runs on each retry attempt. Ground truth in skills/mechanistic/bond_electron_validation/validator.py.

post_step_modules.label: Check Step Atom Balance
post_step_modules.description: RDKit verifies that every atom in the current state appears in the resulting state — no atoms created or destroyed. Part of the mechanism step validation; re-runs on each retry attempt. Ground truth in skills/mechanistic/atom_balance_validation/validator.py.

post_step_modules.label: Check State Changed
post_step_modules.description: Checks that the resulting state differs from the current state and that starting materials are not simply returned unchanged. Part of the mechanism step validation; re-runs on each retry attempt. Ground truth in skills/mechanistic/state_progress_validation/validator.py.

post_step_modules.label: Collect Validation Warnings
post_step_modules.description: Deterministic aggregation of validation warnings from the accepted mechanism step. Runs once per loop iteration after a step passes validation checks. Does not feed back into the current step — it records critique for observability.

post_step_modules.label: Map Atoms for Step
post_step_modules.description: Disabled in threaded_unified (about 30% of calls in jev_reaction_type runs).

post_loop_modules.label: Re-evaluate Soft-Advanced Steps
post_loop_modules.description: After the mechanism loop ends, re-evaluates any steps that were soft-accepted (proceed_on_validation_failure) by attempting deterministic validation fixes in light of later successful steps. Corrected steps are recorded as 'reevaluated' in step_outputs. Has no effect when no soft-accepted steps exist.

sas.description: Single sequential proposer, top-1 candidate only.

centralized_mas.description: Current default. Orchestrator proposes multi-candidate, validates, selects.

independent_mas.description: N independent parallel calls; candidate pools concatenated; no peer sharing.

decentralized_mas.description: N agents x D debate rounds with peer summaries; consensus merge.

metadata.description: Threaded unified harness: one pre-analysis call plus a threaded mechanism loop.

changelog.description: Created from jev_reaction_type: four pre-loop decisions merged into unified_preanalysis (Jev dropped), mechanism proposals threaded with rewind to the last accepted step, branch forks on backtrack and compaction; step_atom_mapping disabled; example reaction-type bypass off.
